📦 **Sculpture `a9278cd`** — feat(tidegrave): prepare game import with supported bower anchors and final rig handoff

Complete author-side Tidegrave import assets: preserve the original hull and sail
fastenings, install supported shared bower anchors with real hawse points, and
retain the measured gun/wheel fairleads and corrected rig routes. Freeze final
VXK, continuous route proofs, raw dynamic failures, and the exact source evidence.

The isolated latest-game integration proposal fixes fore/aft powder crew spawning
outside the deck at the muzzle; broadside spawning is unchanged. Supply measured
ship geo and preserve 0-error shipcheck with all 54 guns fully staffed. Two warnings
remain: 11/12 marines and chase-2 powder navigation connectivity. ame owns actual
Blockside integration and the powder patch/config adoption; that working tree is
untouched by this commit. Tim retains manual cloth dynamic acceptance.

Validated 1034323 body voxels/d931433f, 502 ropes, 10 sails, 168 models, 6 decks,
7 ladders. Current-state repeat exports differ only in exported_at. CLI list/VXK
voxel/color differences are zero; one-cell tamper checksum fails as expected.
Do not claim all historical constructors are safe to rerun from scratch or mark
the known cloth contacts as a full dynamic PASS.
